## Circular to Licensed Corporations and Registered Institutions

## Intermediaries Activities Survey 2003/04

As  an  on-going  exercise  to  maintain  an  up-to-date  profile  of  the  business  activities  of financial  intermediaries  in  Hong  Kong  and  to  assist  the  SFC  in  formulating  appropriate policies  facilitating  market  development,  we  have  now  commenced  the  Intermediaries Activities Survey for the year ended 31 March 2004.  All licensed corporations and registered institutions are requested to participate in this exercise and we appreciate your continued cooperation,  as  in  previous  years,  by  completing  and  returning  the  survey on  or  before  8 October 2004 .  In this current survey, you can download the questionnaire (in Excel format) from the following web-site:

http://www.sfc.hk/sfc/html/EN/forms/licensing/questionnaire/questionnaire.html (Please enable Macros when opening the Excel file)

To  reduce  the  amount  of  paper  work  and  facilitate  data  analysis,  we  request  that,  where possible,  you  submit  your  completed  survey  by  e-mail  or  by  sending  a  floppy  disk  or compact disk to us containing the related Excel file.  The Cover Sheet of the questionnaire provides  the  necessary  instructions  for  returning  the  survey.    If,  for  any  reason,  you  are unable  to  access  the  questionnaire  electronically,  a  hard  copy  of  the  questionnaire  can  be made available to you upon request to your Intermediaries Relationship Manager.

Finally, you may rest assured that all information supplied will be treated in strict confidence and will not be disclosed to third party except in the form of statistics.

If  you  have  any  queries  on  the  above,  please  feel  free  to  contact  your  Intermediaries Relationship Manager.

Licensing Department Intermediaries and Investment Products Division Securities and Futures Commission
